scope: Synthetic compositor audit; not desktop FPS, media decode, Motion, OCIO/ACES or end-to-end project acceptance
worktree: Existing uncommitted changes were present in media, Motion and UI. Renderer production code was unchanged after temporary timing instrumentation was removed.

method.submission: Serial scene plus display, wait for validated completion; 100us polling sleep
method.content: Opaque solid background, LAYERS solid foregrounds with animated opacity and over, optional default Gaussian blur, legacy sRGB display
method.cache: Bypasses application presentation cache; retains renderer and texture pool
method.summary: Wall medians average the two central samples; p95 is nearest rank; GPU median sums scene and display timestamps
method.limitations: Desktop remained running; GPU clocks and competing load were not controlled. Single sweep, not repeated isolated performance qualification. Solid layers emphasize pass/bandwidth overhead and are not representative of every artistic graph. No CPU/GPU pixel comparison in the benchmark itself.

transfers.note: Status readback is separate. Existing upload counters do not account for every uniform/kernel upload; zero image traffic is not zero CPU work.

targeted_instrumentation.workload: 1920 1080, zero foreground layers; repeated warm frames
targeted_instrumentation.finding: Status::new's MAP_READ | COPY_DST readback buffer creation consumed approximately 3.8-5.3ms on scene evaluation; display status creation was typically microseconds. Query and device-local status buffer creation were microseconds. Graph preparation was typically 5-12us.
targeted_instrumentation.interpretation: Allocation call is localized; driver-internal reason and benefit of pooling are not yet proven by an A/B implementation.
targeted_instrumentation.cleanup: All temporary DEBUG-comp-audit instrumentation removed; no production renderer change retained.

budget_probe.note: Artificial diagnostic threshold verifies the benchmark can reject this CPU-floor workload. Not an agreed product performance target.

validation.clippy: Affected release example passed with existing library warnings
